description: SELECTIVE FILLET GOLDEN — the capability a predicate selector structurally CANNOT express (topological-naming.md §1.2). The 40x25x10 plate with exactly ONE top edge rounded (r=5): the front-top edge (shared by the +Z top face and the -Y front face; endpoints (0,0,10)-(40,0,10), length 40), named by a stage-1 EdgeSignature and resolved to that single edge — its three neighbour top edges and everything else stay SHARP. Contrast fillet-plate-r5 (predicate axis_parallel Z rounds ALL 4 vertical edges): this proves click-specific selection. A three-feature TREE (sketch -> extrude -> fillet{edges:picked}) through the evaluate-tree path: planegcs solve -> profile face -> 10 mm prism -> EdgeSignature match against body.edges() (exactly one) -> constant-radius OCCT fillet -> GProp -> tessellation -> content-addressed GLB. Byte-determinism incl. interpreter restart proves the edge RESOLVES the same across a fresh rebuild; the parametrized STEP round-trip re-approximates the single trimmed cylindrical fillet surface.
derivation: Expectations are HAND-DERIVED analytic values, cross-checked against the harness (geometry-gates skill: a golden recorded from buggy output enshrines the bug). Base body is the 40x25x10 box; ONE convex 90-degree edge — the front-top edge, along x, length L=40 — is rounded at r=5.

volume: one convex 90-degree fillet of radius r removes r^2*(1 - pi/4) of material per unit length of edge (a square corner r^2 becomes a quarter disk pi*r^2/4 in cross-section). Over L=40: removed = 40 * r^2*(1 - pi/4) = 40*25*(1 - pi/4) = 1000*(1 - pi/4) = 1000 - 250*pi. volume = 10000 - (1000 - 250*pi) = 9000 + 250*pi = 9785.398163397449 mm^3.

surface_area: unchanged faces — bottom 40*25=1000, back(+Y) 40*10=400. Narrowed planar faces — top loses a 5 mm strip along the filleted edge -> 40*20=800; front(-Y) loses a 5 mm strip -> 40*5=200. The two end faces left(x=0) and right(x=40) each lose the rounded corner at (y=0,z=10): 25*10 - 25*(1 - pi/4) = 225 + 25*pi/4 apiece. Fillet lateral (quarter cylinder r=5, length 40) = (1/4)*(2*pi*r)*L = pi*r*L/2 = 100*pi.

centroid: the body keeps ONE mirror symmetry (the plane x=20, perpendicular to the length-40 edge), so centroid.x = 20 exactly. y and z shift toward the un-removed material. Removed region R is a prism along x (length 40) whose y-z cross-section S = square [0,5]x[5,10] minus the quarter disk (r=5, centre (5,5)); A_S = 25 - 25*pi/4, so V_R = 40*A_S = 1000 - 250*pi. S centroid: square (2.5,7.5) area 25; quarter-disk centroid offset 4r/(3*pi) = 20/(3*pi) from its centre toward the quadrant -> (5 - 20/(3*pi), 5 + 20/(3*pi)). y_S = (62.5 - (25*pi/4)*(5 - 20/(3*pi)))/A_S; z_S = (187.5 - (25*pi/4)*(5 + 20/(3*pi)))/A_S. R centroid = (20, y_S, z_S).

centroid.y = (10000*12.5 - V_R*y_S)/(9000 + 250*pi) = 12.749642075576444 mm; centroid.z = (10000*5 - V_R*z_S)/(9000 + 250*pi) = 4.914839098070588 mm (formula evaluated at full float64 precision; the harness reproduces both to <= 2e-15 mm).

bounding_box = [0,0,0]..[40,25,10]: the fillet is tangent to the front face at z=5 (front persists z 0..5) and to the top face at y=5 (top persists y 5..25), and spans the full x extent; z and the x/y extremes are untouched.

topology: 7 faces (bottom + back + top + front + left + right + 1 quarter-cylinder fillet = original 6 + the fillet), 15 edges (13 straight + 2 quarter arcs where the fillet meets the two end faces), 1 shell. Vertices: the 2 original front-top corners round off into 4 tangent points (top tangent (x,5,10) and front tangent (x,0,5) at x=0 and x=40), so V = 8 - 2 + 4 = 10. Euler for a genus-0 solid: V - E + F = 10 - 15 + 7 = 2.

mesh (linear 0.1 mm / angular 0.1 rad, isRelative=False): each fillet quarter-arc (pi/2 rad) discretizes to 2*ceil((pi/2)/0.1) = 2*16 = 32 segments -- the SAME 2x-angular-estimate rule the fillet-plate and cylinder goldens exhibit. With N=32: the fillet face is a 2x(N+1) grid = 2*N+2 = 66 nodes / 2*N = 64 triangles; each end face (left/right) is a polygon with 5 straight corners + (N-1) arc-interior nodes = N+4 = 36 nodes, triangulated with no interior node -> N+2 = 34 triangles; the 4 remaining planar faces (bottom/back/top/front) are rectangles, 4 nodes / 2 triangles each = 16 nodes / 8 triangles.

mesh totals = 66 + 2*36 + 16 = 154 vertices and 64 + 2*34 + 8 = 140 triangles (per-face faceted normals, no vertex sharing across faces -- the same convention as the box/cylinder/fillet-plate goldens). Closed form: nodes = 26 + 4*N, triangles = 12 + 4*N.

GLB byte size is deliberately NOT pinned here: asserted deterministic (byte-identical) by the runner within one kernel version, but pinning the absolute size would break on glTF-writer upgrades without geometric meaning.
tolerance_rationale: CURVED-GEOMETRY tolerance, measured then set (geometry-gates skill: never copy a bound blindly). The single quarter-cylinder fillet face goes through OCCT's Gauss-quadrature surface/volume integration in GProp -- converging to machine precision but not exact zero. Measured deviations vs the analytic values (2026-07-12, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9, planegcs 0.8.0): volume 2.2e-12 mm^3, surface_area 0.0, centroid <= 2e-15 mm (y and z), AABB exact. Documented ceiling 1e-9 = ~5e2x the observed worst case (volume), matching the fillet-plate-r5 posture (curved geometry, 100x tighter than the standing planar 1e-7 bound) with headroom for libm/platform variation in the quadrature's transcendental evaluations across CI hosts. The solver contributes zero error by construction (zero-residual start, solved == input bitwise). Loosening this bound requires a reviewed kernel-level justification recorded here and in docs/GEOMETRY-QA.md.
